rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a 3AA expanded/full blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona; detailed and consistent with Gardner data, though some image-specific localization/details may be inferred beyond what is strictly verifiable.
Strong integration of age, BMI, AMH, tubal factor diagnosis, prior IVF failure, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with a clear link from morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat speculative effects of stress and precise quantitative adjustments without clear evidence basis.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, eSET, and consideration of PGT-A, but includes less guideline-supported suggestions such as routine low-dose aspirin, ERA after limited failure history, and endometrial scratch.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management and future planning, though some suggested adjuncts are more speculative than standard-of-care.
